{{Youmay|a gaming term|a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] bearing the [[Hand Pot (casino)|same name]]}}
The '''hand pot''' was a small collection of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] collected at the beginning of every [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] round. This prize went to the player with the best hand, regardless of who won the over all match. That prize was known as the [[Sabacc pot/Legends|sabacc pot]].
